name: Arma 3 Server
description: Arma 3 Dedicated Server. Updates to the latest version every time it is restarted. Supports mission configs mods and headless clients.
compose:
services:
  app:
    image: ghcr.io/brettmayson/arma3server/arma3server:latest@sha256:951fb164243d35d815259a9ddd2f9ce7b5375d366c665ee7c78e752717fde815
    container_name: arma3-server
    ports:
      - "2302-2306:2302-2306/udp"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mpmissions:/arma3/mpmissions
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/configs:/arma3/configs
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/mods:/arma3/mods
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/servermods:/arma3/servermods
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/addons:/arma3/addons
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/steamcmd:/steamcmd
    environment:
      - STEAM_USER=${STEAM_USER:-}
      - STEAM_PASSWORD=${STEAM_PASSWORD:-}
      - PORT=2302
      - ARMA_CONFIG=main.cfg
      - ARMA_PROFILE=main
      - ARMA_WORLD=empty
      - ARMA_LIMITFPS=100
      - ARMA_BINARY=./arma3server_x64
      - ARMA_PARAMS=
      - TZ=UTC
    restart: unless-stopped
